lines.text: The Philistines and Ammonites oppressed Israel in Gilead for seven years, and the Ammonites crossed the Jordan to fight Judah.
Israel cried out to the LORD, and though He said He would no longer save them, they put away foreign gods.
The Ammonites camped in Gilead and the Israelites camped at Shiloh, and the rulers of Gilead offered leadership to whoever attacked.
